ResearchForge RL: Scientific Discovery Environments

FlaneAI/Scientific-Research-RL

Run multi-turn scientific-discovery episodes in a simulator by issuing JSON actions such as observe until the episode ends.

Open on Hugging FaceHow to run it

Good for

  • multi-turn verifiable-reward RL
  • local Python runtime for custom adapters

Terminal scores are computed by the simulator, not a language-model judge.

How to run it

1. From the cardcopied from the publisher's own instructions

from researchforge.hub import load_tasks, ResearchSession
task = load_tasks('train')[0]
session = ResearchSession(task)
state = session.reset()
result = session.step({'action': 'observe', 'n': 2})

2. Get the filesthe whole repository, to a local folder

hf download FlaneAI/Scientific-Research-RL --repo-type dataset --local-dir Scientific-Research-RL

Needs: Python; pip install -e '.[dev]'.
